subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Decide if an email is formal or informal from the subject and style.
Read two emails and answer questions.
Learn words from the emails and their opposites.

tf.s: The two emails are informal emails between friends.
tf.why: Yes, they are friendly, informal emails.

tf.s: The shopping centre Nawal visited has 1,200 shops.
Nawal loves shopping and bought lots of things.
tf.why: Nawal hates shopping, so she didn't buy anything.

tf.s: The shopping centre has more than 200 places to eat.
tf.why: Right, more than 200 places to eat.

tf.s: There is an underwater zoo and aquarium at the shopping centre.
tf.why: Yes, and an ice rink and a cinema.

tf.s: Rasha went to the shops to buy a new phone.
tf.why: She went to complain about a T-shirt and get a refund.

tf.s: Rasha felt embarrassed because she had taken her little sister's T-shirt by mistake.
tf.why: Well done, that was her mistake.
Yes, sell and buy are opposites.
The opposite of first is last.

boxes.q: How many shops are in the shopping centre?
What should you read first in an inbox?
boxes.why: The subject tells you what the email is about.

boxes.q: Why did Rasha go to the shops?
boxes.why: She wanted a refund for a T-shirt.

boxes.q: What word means wanting what someone else has?
boxes.why: Jealous means wanting what others have.

boxes.q: Feeling uncomfortable because of a mistake is ...

boxes.why: Love is the opposite of hate.
Yesterday is the opposite of tomorrow.

boxes.q: Where can you skate at the shopping centre?
boxes.why: You skate on an ice rink.

mcq.q: What else can you do at the shopping centre if you get bored of shopping?
o: visit the underwater zoo, the ice rink or the cinema
mcq.why: There are fun places besides shops.

mcq.q: Are the emails formal or informal?
mcq.why: They are friendly emails between friends.
Jealous is wanting what others have.

mcq.q: Choose the word: The shopping centre was ___; it had 1,200 shops!
Your friend went to an amazing place. You wish you were there too. You feel ...
mcq.why: Jealous: wanting what someone else had.

mcq.q: Find the opposites: hate, sell, first.
mcq.why: love, buy and last are the opposites.

o: She had taken her little sister's T-shirt by mistake.
mcq.why: Her complaint was about the wrong T-shirt.

mcq.q: How can you tell an email is informal before reading it?
o: Look at the subject line and who it is from, like a friend.
mcq.why: The subject and sender show if it is friendly.
